overall_goal: Clean up the workspace by putting away ingredients, clearing used utensils to the sink, and wiping the chopping board.

goals.description: Put away ingredients into the cabinet and refrigerator
goals.rationale: The person seals the salt jar, places the olive oil and salt into the bottom cabinet, and stores the packet of ghee in the refrigerator.

goals.description: Move used utensils and tools to the sink for washing
goals.rationale: The person gathers a spoon, measuring jug, tumbler, and plastic chopping board, empties leftover food from the tumbler into the bin, and places all the items into the sink.
The person tidies up the workspace by arranging the mortar and pestle, folding the notebook, capping the pen, and moving the weighing scale.

goals.description: Wipe the wooden chopping board and dispose of food debris
goals.rationale: The person uses a kitchen rag to scrub the wooden chopping board, collects the debris into their hand, and throws it into the rubbish bin.
